text:
incident-bot: ALERT: region=ap-sg cluster=inference-ap-sg-01 p95 latency > 12s for 6m. paging @oncall-ap. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ap-latency
oncall-ap: Ack'd — joining bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridges/9753
sam: I'm on the bridge. quick check: a bunch of KV cache evictions on hosts apg-*-02 and an obvious routing tilt towards model_variant=fp16-lowmem
priya: CS update: two customers flagged timeouts and 504s from SG region in the last 12m — acct IDs A-773, A-802. They're retrying and seeing elevated latency.
nina: pulling logs now. cmd: `journalctl -u inference-service -n 500 | rg "kv evict|rewarm|timeout"`
sam: looks like a scheduled rewarm loop coincided with a routing reshuffle after a deploy to modelpool-ap. some hosts rewarming large prefixes and briefly spiking CPU.
ops-bot: deploybot: automatic rollback of last modelpool-ap deploy detected  — holding new rollouts
priya: CS: customers are asking for status. Suggest we flip traffic off the saturated hosts to a compatible fallback variant and open a targeted capacity burst for pool-ap.
sam: I'll do a staged route shift to fallback-compat with 20% -> 60% -> 100% checks at 45s. ops-bot please run the rollout.
ops-bot: deploybot: route change submitted by sam -> rollout 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 45s checks
oncall-ap: After 60% flip p95 down from ~11s to ~700ms, error rate falling. Holding to observe for 10m. great reflexes. :clap:
sre_lead: Good containment. We should schedule a postmortem and capture concrete actions. Propose owners: sam + priya. Suggestions for action items below.
priya: I'll prepare customer notification draft for the affected accounts after PM.
sam: Quick list of action items from bridge: A1: (sam) add routing safety: never route >75% traffic to hosts with rewarm_rate > X for 5m. due: EOD tomorrow. A2: (nina) instrument eviction/rewarm events with structured fields: pool, host, prefix_size. due: 48h. A3: (sre_lead) adjust alerting: require sustained p95 > 6s AND errors > 0.15% over 4m to page. due: 3d. A4: (priya) customer comms postmortem and timeline. due: after PM. A5: (sre_lead) review autoscale thresholds for modelpool-ap; ensure burst capacity peers evenly. due: 7d.
ops-bot: checklist: created incident-runbook ticket IR-2026-319 and Ops action tracker entry
sam: opened logs PR: https://git.redwood/infra/logs/pull/431 — adds eviction events and example JSON payloads
nina: I'll add sample query snippets to correlate rewarm spree with routing shifts and share Grafana panel links
sre_lead: Proposed alert rewrite (to reduce pages for transient non-error latency spikes):
```
alert: HighInferenceLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, modelpool, region)) > 6
for: 4m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/latency
  note: "Only page if error ratio exceeds threshold"
```
Additional gating (to implement in alertmanager): require: sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) > 0.0015
sam: agreeing on gating — evictions can blow up p95 without customer-visible errors, so this will cut noisy wakes
priya: proposed PM time: Thu 09:30 PT (2026-03-26 16:30 UTC). owners: sam, priya. I'll post calendar invite and create postmortem doc.
sre_lead: please include the deploy/route history, log excerpts, and a timeline of the rewarm events in the PM doc. Also decide if we want a quick patch to the rewarm controller to stagger restarts.
oncall-ap: closing incident channel for mitigation phase. Reopen thread when PM doc ready. Thanks team — fast containment.
sam: thanks all. I'll mark A1/A3 in Ops tracker and follow up on PR review.
priya: drafting customer messages and will share for review in #customer-comms.
incident-bot: incident closed for mitigation at 2469124010. postmortem scheduled.
